neighbours.label: marker introducing the standard of a comparison ('than', 'from' after different, 'unlike', 'first time in')
fire: Exports this year were twenty percent higher than in 2019.
The soil on the hill has a different texture from the soil in the valley.
Prices in the city are much lower than they were a decade ago.
Unlike anything else in the museum, the statue is made of glass.
For the first time in recorded history, the river froze completely.
Her new car is far more efficient than the old one she drove.
Island birds often look very different from birds on the mainland.
The second test was easier than anyone in the class had expected.
quiet: Exports this year were twenty percent of the total in 2019.
The soil on the hill has a rough texture and dries out quickly.
Prices in the city went up again a decade ago.
Like many things in the museum, the statue is made of glass.
In recorded history, the river froze completely only in winter.
Her new car is very efficient and she drives it to work.
Island birds often look very colorful and build nests on cliffs.
The second test was given to everyone in the class on Monday.
